caption: The drawing is composed of three main views and one outline of a fork, all rendered in grayscale pencil on a plain background. In the upper section of the drawing, two forks are shown vertically, side by side, both viewed from the front; the left fork’s handle bears engraved initials or letters, while both handles have an outlined, heart-shaped or scalloped design at their ends. Both forks have four tines. In the lower section, a single fork is depicted horizontally in a perspective view, showing more detail along the handle, including the same heart-shaped pattern and visible engraving. At the top left corner of the drawing, there is a small rectangular inset displaying a single, simple contour line tracing the side profile of the fork, showing its curvature. The drawing uses varying shades of gray and black to create shading and detail, and has no background elements or additional colors.
title: Silver Fork
